$comment: Classification register for official and manufacturer sources of the 993. 'families' records, for each system of the assembly skeleton, at least one qualified source (official or manufacturer, evidence level A or B) and where in it the family is covered. 'sources' records model years and dated availability observations only where a record states them or where this register states its own dated observation; a source absent from 'sources' is not classified, which says nothing about its years or availability. Validated by scripts/validate_registers.py.
rules: Model years are recorded only from text already present in the source record (title, coverage.variants or notes), quoted verbatim; nothing is inferred from the generation alone.
Every availability observation is dated and names the channel it was observed on. It describes that channel on that day, not the market.

Absence of a part number from the Porsche Classic Parts Finder, or from any vendor search, is recorded as not_listed_on_channel. It is not proof that the part or the publication is discontinued; discontinued_per_publisher requires an explicit statement by the publisher.
A listing is not a purchase and not an offer to buy: purchases and subscriptions are owner decisions.

families.name: Controls, pedals and clutch actuation

qualified_sources.location: Kat 017 illustrations 701-00 to 702-10 (8 illustrations, 494 references in catalog/reference/993-assembly-skeleton.json); part identity and assembly order, no dimensions

repair group 30 'Clutch, Controls' PDF pages 261 to 263 and 'Clutch, Operation' p. 268 to 276 (servo spring setting dimension, clutch pedal travel, brake light switch travel, fastener sizes); Tiptronic selector lever fasteners p. 444 and 447 and selector controls p. 456 and 466; pedal travel in the maintenance chapter p. 35; brake pedal plate p. 726 and 728. All values from p. 261 to 276 are ocr_unreviewed. PDF pages are those of the consulted copy indexed in catalog/measurements/MEAS-MANUAL-993-ALL.json.

families.gaps: Official coverage exists but is limited to assembly breakdown and service settings. No official source gives the geometry of the pedals, the shift lever, the handbrake lever or the clutch actuation parts; the only dimensional records for this family are community or aftermarket (SRC-PFF-993-BRAKE-LIGHT-SWITCH-TRAVEL, SRC-PARTWORKS-993-THROTTLE-LINKAGE-BUSHING-DIMENSIONS). The pedal box and the handbrake belong to the braking system and are excluded from release.
